jobs.title: Concierge Security Officer — Full-Time, Benefits
jobs.description: GardaWorld Security is hiring a Concierge Security Officer in Austin, TX. The role centers on customer service, welcoming visitors, verifying identities, and guiding guests across office towers, hotels, and shopping environments. You will control access, patrol for risks, and report incidents with coordination to emergency teams. A Texas license and clean driving record are required or obtainable.
